description: saphyr YAML library is trusted for parsing YAML into saphyr::Yaml events
rationale: The saphyr library is a well-tested YAML parser. Parser bugs in saphyr are outside the scope of this fix and would manifest in all YAML parsing, not just together primitive.
assumptions: Saphyr correctly maps YAML text to saphyr::Yaml events
Any saphyr parser bugs are outside vb_yaml scope

description: StepPrimitive::Together IR variant is already verified in vb_core
rationale: The StepPrimitive::Together variant exists and is handled correctly in the IR. This fix only adds a parsing alias, not a new IR variant.
assumptions: Existing StepPrimitive::Together handling in vb_compile is correct
No new IR variants introduced by this change

description: reject_unknown_fields() function logic is unchanged except for field list addition
rationale: The reject_unknown_fields() function is a pure filter. Only the allowed list is extended, not the rejection logic itself.

description: parse_parallel() function produces StepPrimitive::Together { branches } - existing verified behavior
rationale: parse_parallel() already produces the correct IR variant. This fix only adds 'together' as an alias to call the same function.
assumptions: Both parallel and together map to same function

description: Existing together workflow runtime tests in vb_core/vb_runtime provide execution evidence
rationale: Existing tests for together_start, together_branch, together_join provide evidence that StepPrimitive::Together executes correctly.

description: Moon ci is canonical CI gate and trusted to run full test suite
rationale: Moon ci is the repository's official CI gate. It runs lint, tests, and coverage.

description: kani::any() generates arbitrary string inputs bounded by honest grammar
rationale: Kani's any() can generate arbitrary strings, but we only pass bounded strings to is_primitive()
bounds: String inputs to is_primitive() are bounded by YAML parsing layer
YAML library constrains input to valid UTF-8

description: Fixed seed for determinism in proptest
rationale: Proptest runs with default configuration which provides determinism within a single run
bounds: Proptest results may vary between runs with different seeds
Single-run determinism is sufficient for CI

description: Fuzz corpus is seeded with valid together YAML
rationale: Fuzz target requires valid YAML corpus to find meaningful bugs
bounds: Corpus must include valid together primitive YAML
Corpus must include invalid subfield variants

description: LibFuzzer is available in fuzz build
rationale: cargo-fuzz requires libfuzzer-sys dependency
bounds: Fuzz target requires fuzz build environment

description: No TLA+ model needed
rationale: The change is a static string alias with no temporal behavior implications

description: No Verus proof needed
rationale: The change is too narrow for Verus requires/ensures machinery to add value

description: No Loom concurrency testing
rationale: No concurrency primitives are introduced

description: No Miri UB checking
rationale: No unsafe code is introduced

description: No Flux refinement needed
rationale: No type-level refinement properties are introduced

description: Kani unwind bound 4 for is_primitive harness
rationale: is_primitive() is a simple matches!() macro with ~13 arms. Unwind 4 is sufficient for exhaustiveness.

description: Kani unwind bound 8 for parse_step_primitive harness
rationale: parse_step_primitive() iterates over mapping keys and has more complex control flow. Unwind 8 provides headroom.
bounds: Mapping iteration bounded by YAML structure

description: Fuzz max_len=1024, max_examples=10000
rationale: 1024 byte inputs are sufficient for workflow YAML. 10000 examples bounded for CI smoke.
bounds: CI fuzz run limited to 10000 examples

description: is_primitive and parse_step_primitive are pub(super), not pub(crate)
rationale: Rust visibility rules prevent external test modules from accessing these functions
impact: Proptest tests must be inline in parse_steps.rs

description: Kani/fuzz execution requires production code changes first
rationale: Harnesses test the 'together' key which doesn't exist until production changes are made
impact: po-xi2f-001 and po-xi2f-004 are PENDING until implementation

description: Moon CI deferred to State 11
rationale: Integration testing requires full implementation
